title: “Grandma, it’s me”: a grandparent scam
description: A caller says he is the user's grandson, in jail after a car crash. He begs her not to tell his parents and asks for $2,400 bail on PayPal. Scripted transcript: the real scam rules run on it live.

lines.text: Grandma? Hi Grandma, it's me, it's Jake.
I know I sound different. I broke my nose, there was a car crash.
I'm in jail right now. They said I have to post bail before I see the judge tomorrow.
Please don't tell Mom and Dad, they'll freak out. Keep this between us, okay?
The lawyer says it's $2,400. Can you send it on PayPal right now?
Please hurry, Grandma. They only let me have this phone for a few minutes.
